review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded implementation of the frontend presentation and interaction layer for AI event tracing. It includes the span builder, parent lookup, and tests for display behavior, along with the UI banner and feature flags. The tier is established by the visible frontend implementation and its tests, not by unverified backend behavior.
